title: UI风格#89 - Retro Polaroid (复古宝丽来)
description: 创建第89种UI风格：复古宝丽来风格 - 拍立得照片、柔和色调、纸质边缘。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planCK.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Polaroid style When color palette Then features cream white, soft pastels, faded colors, instant photo border
Given Retro Polaroid style When typography Then uses handwritten fonts: Patrick Hand, Caveat, or Coming Soon
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Caveat (headers 3rem 600 weight), Patrick Hand (body 1rem), Coming Soon (status text)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Polaroid style When layout Then polaroid frames, scattered photos, tape effects
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: polaroid-style white borders, tape decorations, slight rotation on cards (1-2deg), paper texture overlay, soft pastel color scheme

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Polaroid style When UI elements Then photo borders, tape corners, slight rotation
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: polaroid white borders (6-8px), tape decorations on cards, alternating rotation on memory cards, hover transform to straighten, warm tan borders

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Polaroid UI When functional Then includes photo chat, memory agents, album stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: memory album chat, 4 memory agents (Flash/Vintage/Palette/Lens) with Photos/Focus/Albums/Nostalgia/Colors/Tone/Shutter/Clarity stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Polaroid UI When copy Then uses memory lane: 'Snapshot', 'Memory', 'Capture', 'Moment'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'SNAPSHOT. MEMORY. MOMENT.', tagline 'Every picture tells a story', button 'SNAP', greeting 'Smile! What memory shall we capture', status 'Captured'/'Idle', nav 'Photo'/'Darkroom'/'Journal'/'Album'
